verdictReason: Part (a) passes: the switch is there and off. Part (b) did not show the expected 'Turn on internet downloads?' box: the button I reached first opens the older 'Update Ollama and models?' confirm with the ring on 'Start update', so the new download notice was never seen. Nothing downloaded (0 pull lines twice). The downloads box may only come after 'Start update', which I must not press; the session decides whether to try 'Install options… > Tier 1 essentials' or 'Update knowledge base' another time.
